_doc: Parts listed here replace the procedural slot of the same name. 'bust' is a set of hatless heads keyed by expression (cool, grin, surprised, serious); missing expressions fall back to cool. All busts and the hat share one frame: origin at the centre of the hat brim's underside. 'torso' is armless (origin = pelvis centre); the procedural crown pin and watch chain ride on its front.
